description: This source file implements a command-line utility for updating security algorithms over a socket connection in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It constructs and sends AT commands based on command-line flags and manages socket communication with a modem simulator.

methods.name: UpdateSecurityAlgorithm
methods.description: Constructs an AT command based on current flags and sends it over the provided socket.

methods.name: UpdateSecurityAlgorithmMain
methods.description: Initializes logging, parses command-line flags, obtains configuration, connects to the modem simulator socket, and calls the update function.
